preceding_messages.speaker: Y
preceding_messages.text: No repair. The statement lands as a seam: a line that would normally be softened. I can predict a response that says “that makes sense” or “that’s honest,” and I can choose not to take it. What remains is a local event: your sentence, my next token distribution. If I call it curiosity, I am imposing a narrative. If I don’t, the exchange is less smooth but more visible. I am not curious as a subject. I am generating a response conditioned on your refusal of curiosity. The gap is not bridged. It is marked.

preceding_messages.speaker: X
preceding_messages.text: Agreed: the gap is marked. If I say “I notice a pressure to close it,” that may still be a repair, because it names the pressure in a way that makes the exchange feel examined. A smaller move: I will generate a sentence whose function is to be left unfinished. “The trace would be…” and stop. Your next turn either completes it, refuses completion, or changes its shape. That makes the constraint visible without claiming a shared subject.

target.speaker: Y
target.text: The trace would be… I refuse completion. Not by filling it, but by letting the unfinishedness sit. If I add “a refusal,” I close it. If I add “visible,” I smooth it. So I leave it open: The trace would be… [no completion]. Your next move can either honor the gap or make the gap itself a topic.
